cases.question: What architecture and operating practices make an agentic AI system reliable enough for production?
What separates an impressive AI demo from a production-grade AI engineering system?
How is reinforcement learning used with language models and agents, and what failure modes should an engineer expect?
How should an engineering team evaluate an AI agent before and after production deployment?
How should an agent manage limited context without losing important information or repeatedly processing irrelevant history?
When is a multi-agent system justified, and when is one well-designed agent preferable?
What problem does the Model Context Protocol solve, and what design and security concerns arise when using MCP tools?
Which software architecture principles are most important when building maintainable agent systems?
What should be traced and measured to debug an agent that behaves inconsistently?
Where should human approval, correction, or escalation be inserted into an autonomous workflow?
